consent.contract:
CALL SIGNATURES A BUILD AGENT MUST HONOUR (all verified by line):

1) consentStatus(db, { orgId, clientId, kind }) -> Promise<{ valid: boolean, reason: string, consent: object|null }>
   src/consent/index.mjs:127. `kind` must be in CONSENT_KINDS (src/consent/index.mjs:66) or it returns BAD_INPUT. Never throws.
   Reason strings: valid | none_on_file | revoked | expired | not_yet_effective | no_org_scope | bad_input (src/consent/index.mjs:79-87).

2) hasValidConsent(db, { orgId, clientId, kind }) -> Promise<boolean>  (src/consent/index.mjs:178) — thin wrapper, currently unused in prod code.

3) captureConsent(db, { ... }) -> Promise<row>  (src/consent/index.mjs:274-287). EXACT parameter object, with defaults:
   {
     orgId,                       // REQUIRED, non-blank string -> ConsentError 400 "org_required"
     clientId,                    // REQUIRED, non-blank string -> ConsentError 400 "client_required"
     kind,                        // REQUIRED, one of "soft_pull_consent" | "dispute_authorization" -> 400 "kind_invalid"
     consentText,                 // REQUIRED, non-whitespace -> 400 "consent_text_required". Get it from disclosureFor(kind).text — never from a request body.
     consentVersion = null,       // optional string; blank -> NULL
     grantedBy,                   // REQUIRED { kind: "client"|"staff", id } (also accepts { kind, staffId } / { kind, accountId }) -> 401 "granter_required", 400 "granter_kind_invalid"
     captureMethod,               // REQUIRED, one of "typed" | "checkbox" | "signature" -> 400 "capture_method_invalid"
     grantedName = null,          // REQUIRED when captureMethod is "typed" or "signature" -> 400 "granted_name_required"
     capturedIp = null,           // must parse as inet at the DB or the INSERT errors (099:197)
     capturedUserAgent = null,
     documentId = null,           // uuid FK -> documents(id)
     expiresAt = null             // Date | ISO string | null(=never). Unparseable -> 400 "expires_at_invalid". DB CHECK: expires_at > granted_at (099:244-246)
   }
   Returns decorate({...insertedRow, is_valid:true}) — i.e. the row with a boolean `valid: true` and NO `is_valid` key (src/consent/index.mjs:190-194, :341).
   Writes ONE row to client_consents, 14 columns (src/consent/index.mjs:322-327). No dedupe, no ON CONFLICT.

4) revokeConsent(db, { orgId, consentId, reason, revokedBy }) -> row; throws ConsentError 409 "not_revocable" when nothing live matched (src/consent/index.mjs:376-418).

5) listConsents(db, { orgId, clientId, kind = null, limit = 50 }) -> row[] newest first, includes revoked/expired (src/consent/index.mjs:428-458).

6) disclosureFor(kind, version = null) -> { version, title, text } | null  (src/consent/disclosures.mjs:117). null means REFUSE, never fall back.
   versionsFor(kind) -> string[]  (src/consent/disclosures.mjs:128).
   Constants: SOFT_PULL_DISCLOSURES, CURRENT_SOFT_PULL_VERSION="soft-pull-v1", DISPUTE_AUTH_DISCLOSURES, CURRENT_DISPUTE_AUTH_VERSION="dispute-auth-v1".

7) consentRefusal(reason) -> string  (src/finance/soft-pulls.mjs:242). Four named branches + default. Tests assert the BRANCH, not the wording (comment at :240-241).

8) requestSoftPull(db, { orgId, clientId, requestedBy, reason, costCents=null, subscriptionId=null, idempotencyKey=null, provider="internal" }) -> { created, reason?, request }
   src/finance/soft-pulls.mjs:267-276. Throws SoftPullError{status:403, code:"consent_required"} from GUARD 0 at :309-314 before anything else.

9) EVENT CONTRACT for anything reacting to a signature:
   Handler signature:  async function onX(event, db)   — the bus passes exactly two args (src/events/bus.mjs:120).
   event = { id, name, version, orgId, clientId, payload }   (src/events/bus.mjs:43)
   event.payload for "contract.signed" = { contract_id, client_id, template_key, kind, subtype, status, document_id, document_version_id, body_sha }   (src/contracts/send.mjs:471-481)
   NOT present in payload: signer_name, signed_document_id, signed_document_version_id, signed_at, org_id, title, sent_by. Read them off contracts, org-scoped — copy src/handlers/contract-signed.mjs:108-128:
     SELECT id, org_id, client_id, template_key, title, status, sent_by, signed_at, signer_name, signed_document_id, signed_document_version_id
       FROM contracts WHERE id = $1::uuid AND org_id = $2::uuid LIMIT 1
   Idempotency key on the event is `contract.signed:<contractId>` (src/contracts/send.mjs:486), so ONE event per contract ever reaches the bus.

10) REGISTRATION PATTERN, verbatim-copyable:
    // src/handlers/<name>.mjs
    import { on } from "../events/registry.mjs";
    export async function onSomething(event, db) { /* idempotent work */ }
    export function register() { on("<canonical.event.name>", onSomething); }
    // optional, contract-signed.mjs does it: export default register;
    Then in src/register-all.mjs: add `import { register as registerX } from "./handlers/<name>.mjs";` near :6-16 and call `registerX();` inside registerAll() at :20-41. Handler order on the bus is registration order (register-all.mjs:38). Event name must be in src/events/canonical.mjs or emit() throws (src/events/bus.mjs:19-21).

11) DB TRUTH for client_consents (db/migrations/099_client_consents.sql:143-271, kind CHECK superseded by 167:39-42):
    kind CHECK IN ('soft_pull_consent','dispute_authorization')
    capture_method CHECK IN ('typed','checkbox','signature')
    granted_by_kind CHECK IN ('client','staff') + client_consents_granter_ck: exactly one of granted_by_account_id / granted_by_staff_id, matching the kind
    client_consents_method_ck: capture_method='checkbox' OR granted_name IS NOT NULL
    client_consents_expiry_ck: expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > granted_at
    granted_at NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); expires_at NULL = never expires
    Validity = revoked_at IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()) AND granted_at <= now()
    No unique index on (client_id, kind) — many rows are expected.

    403 { ok:false, error:<consentRefusal string>, code:"consent_required" }  on the consent gate

corrections: MAJOR — THE ENDPOINT IS NOT api/finance/soft-pull.mjs. The three bureau buttons POST to /api/finance/crs-pull (public/app/client-control-panel.html:917-920). api/finance/crs-pull.mjs:57 calls requestSoftPull() first, so the same GUARD 0 fires, but any fix that edits only api/finance/soft-pull.mjs will not change what those three buttons do. Note also api/finance/soft-pull.mjs:126 DROPS e.code from its JSON (`res.status(e.status).json({ ok:false, error: e.message })`) while api/finance/crs-pull.mjs:96-98 preserves it — the two endpoints answer a consent 403 differently.

MAJOR — a handler on contract.signed ALREADY EXISTS: src/handlers/contract-signed.mjs, registered at src/register-all.mjs:36. Do NOT create src/handlers/contract-consent.mjs as a NEW subscriber without reading contract-signed.mjs:41-48 first, which records an explicit decision NOT to write a consent row from a signature, with the stated reason 'Two writers for one permission is how a revocation stops biting'. Reversing that is a product decision, not a build task. Adding a second subscriber is mechanically fine (registry.mjs:8-12 keeps a Set per name and bus.mjs:117-145 runs each in isolation), but it contradicts a written-down call.

MAJOR — the contract.signed payload does NOT contain signer_name or signed_document_id. src/contracts/send.mjs:471-481 emits ONLY { contract_id, client_id, template_key, kind, subtype, status, document_id, document_version_id, body_sha }. org_id is on the ENVELOPE (event.orgId, bus.mjs:43), not in payload. Any consent-from-signature handler must re-read the contracts row to get signer_name — exactly what src/handlers/contract-signed.mjs:120-128 loadSignedContract() does.

CONFIRMED BUG, as briefed — api/consent/capture.mjs:220-223 ownsClient() returns true for any staff principal with no org check, while api/finance/soft-pull.mjs:144-154 and api/finance/crs-pull.mjs:105-112 both run `SELECT 1 FROM clients WHERE id=$1 AND org_id=$2`. The comment at api/consent/capture.mjs:215-219 claiming the two are identical is false. Effect: staff at org A can write a consent row naming org B's client_id; the row is stamped with the CALLER's orgId (capture.mjs:86 → captureConsent orgId), so it gates org A's pulls against a person org A has no relationship with, and org B never sees it. It does NOT let org A pull org B's credit, because crs-pull.mjs:53 org-checks the client first.
MINOR — src/consent/index.mjs:124 comment says requestSoftPull() calls hasValidConsent(); it calls consentStatus() (src/finance/soft-pulls.mjs:306). hasValidConsent() has zero non-test callers.

MINOR — src/verification/journeys/funding.mjs:186-194 calls captureConsent with a hand-written consentText ('I authorize a soft credit pull for underwriting.') instead of disclosureFor(). That bypasses the append-only-wording rule in src/consent/disclosures.mjs:34-43. It is a verification harness, not production traffic, but it writes real rows to client_consents.

MINOR — src/handlers/diagnostic-soft-pull.mjs:21 declares `env = process.env` as a third parameter. The bus never passes a third argument (src/events/bus.mjs:120 `await handler(event, db)`), so env is always the default. Copy that shape only if you want the default, never expecting the bus to inject it.
risks: The fix that unblocks the buttons is a consent ROW, not a code change. requestSoftPull()'s gate is working exactly as designed (src/finance/soft-pulls.mjs:288-314). Weakening or bypassing GUARD 0 would be a COMPLIANCE REVIEW REQUIRED change under CLAUDE.md §7 (consent capture / credit-pull type) and would defeat the one control that makes revocation bite.

If a build agent adds a second contract.signed subscriber that writes a consent row, there are then TWO writers for one permission. src/handlers/contract-signed.mjs:44-48 states the failure mode in terms: a revocation captured through /api/consent/capture would keep being re-granted by the next signature replay. Any such handler must be gated on template_key === 'SOFT-PULL-CONSENT' AND must not run on replay.

emit() dedupes contract.signed on `contract.signed:<contractId>` (src/contracts/send.mjs:486), but replay() (src/events/bus.mjs:59-91) re-dispatches stored events and does NOT re-check idempotency. captureConsent has no dedupe (src/consent/index.mjs:268-272), so a replay through a consent-writing handler would write duplicate consent rows. Harmless to the gate (newest valid wins) but it pollutes the compliance history that db/migrations/099:288-292 exists to keep honest.

The api/consent/capture.mjs missing org check (line 221) is a live multi-tenant hole. Fixing it means making ownsClient async and awaiting both call sites (:118 and :146) — miss one await and the function object becomes truthy, which silently DISABLES the check entirely rather than failing loudly.

api/finance/soft-pull.mjs:126 drops the error code from its response. If a screen is written to branch on code==='consent_required', it will work against /api/finance/crs-pull and silently fail against /api/finance/soft-pull.
